title: STF.------DEF.
description: Chart on book p. 56 (BK(NM)-32). STY (style) is the subject; DEF (definition) is the partner. The title's first code, STF (source transfer), is drawn at the lower end of the straight line whose upper end is DEF. From the subject: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: DEF and STF. From DEF: ACC-DYM (accelerated dynamics). From ACC-DYM: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From SOC-RT-DY: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics).
